tools.name: create_share_link
tools.description: Make a read-only share link for canvas frames so other people can view the design and comment. The user must click Allow in Design Studio first; without the window open it is refused. Returns the link URL once (only a hash of the token is kept). A share link is a read-only PNG snapshot of canvas frames, served on a separate listener on this computer (127.0.0.1) unless the user turns on Allow on local network in the Share dialog. Viewers can only see the images and add comments with a name they type; those comments land as drafts in the studio Comments pane, marked as from a viewer, and never go to the studio agent unless the user sends them. The link has a random token, ends after its expiry and can be revoked. Links are off until someone creates one. A live link (live: true) swaps in new snapshots after each saved version and shows viewer cursors in the studio; viewers still get only PNGs, never the design code or a studio API.

directionId.description: Direction id. Leave out for the main direction.

frames.description: Frame ids or @labels from canvas_list. Leave out for every visible frame of the direction.

title.description: Title on the shared page. Leave out for the project name.

live.description: Live link: viewers get new PNG snapshots each time a version is saved, and their cursors show on the studio canvas. The studio cursor shows to viewers only if the user turns it on in Share.

tools.name: list_share_links
tools.description: List the share links of a project: id, title, frames, expiry, whether each is active, and how many viewer comments came in. Read only; it never returns tokens or URLs. Read viewer comments with list_comments. tools.name: revoke_share_link
tools.description: Turn off a share link now. The link, its images and its comment form stop working at once and the snapshot images are deleted. Comments already sent stay in the Comments pane.

shareId.description: Share link id from list_share_links or create_share_link.
